build_requirements_fixer: build a RequirementsFixer instance with a BMGraphBuilder and LatticeTyper to fix BMG type system violations
run_fix_problems: run fix_problems on a RequirementsFixer to traverse all graph nodes and fix type requirement violations
run_requirements_fixer_module: run the requirements_fixer module function on a BMGraphBuilder to auto-fix type requirements and get errors
review_meet_requirement: review the meet_requirement method to understand how a consumer node input is validated and converted to meet edge requirements
review_try_to_meet_constant_requirement: review the _try_to_meet_constant_requirement method to understand how constant nodes are converted to meet type requirements
